answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: before an agent can earn, it must lock scarce collateral behind a unique cipher-signed key, so spawning a thousand clones means posting a thousand real bonds, not launching a costless whisper campaign of sock-puppets. Peers continuously cross-attest conduct, and the honest timber of a long, stake-backed track record cannot be forged overnight. Any agent caught coordinating fakes forfeits its bond, so sybil farms stay unprofitable because the fraud costs more than it can ever extract.
